as_told.title: Beings conditioned him not to tell anyone at Vandenberg

plain: In 1964, at a Minuteman nuclear missile site called D5 on Vandenberg Air Force Base in California, a missile guard named Richard Barth says he saw a shadow in the fog, and then a man or humanlike figure stepped out of it and took him away. Barth tells it as his own experience: he says the being apologised and explained that they had to have access to the site, that he felt both terror and love, and that it was too vivid and real for anyone to have staged it. He says he never told anyone on the base because the beings had somehow conditioned or hypnotised him not to.
